referenceFunction.generalComment: The run-of-river hydropower station is assumed to have a small reservoir where the water is retained. This leads to a higher consumption of land as well as to greenhouse gas emissions due to the collected biomass. The data set describes a mix and is therefore not representative for individual plants. This dataset is recalculated based on Frischknecht et al. (1996) and Bauer (2007), complemented with data from Vattenfall (2008) and Axpo (2008); UUID: b34c3c41-226c-398d-8754-2d14f351afe2
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Operation of average of run-of-river power stations with a small reservoir. It includes the land area transformed and occupied, lubricant oil consumption, spill and disposal, turbined water and greenhouse gas emissions.
referenceFunction.localName: Electricity, hydropower, at run-of-river power plant with reservoir
referenceFunction.name: Electricity, hydropower, at run-of-river power plant with reservoir

geography.text: Average electricity production of Swiss run-of-river hydropower plants. GHG emissions valid for temperate zones.

technology.text: Mix of run-of-river hydropower plants built between 1945 and 1980, representative for Switzerland. Efficiency: 0.82.
